The '''Kelita valley''' was a verdant river valley on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]. Located in Mandalore's northern hemisphere, the Kelita valley was broad and shallow, with dense [[Tree/Legends|woodlands]] and spreads of cultivated [[Farm/Legends|farmland]], punctuated by circular, fortified [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] homesteads. Across the Kelita valley, numerous [[Water/Legends|tributaries]] streamed into and fed the larger [[Kelita River]] that flowed on toward Mandalore's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Keldabe/Legends|Keldabe]]. On one side of the Kelita valley, at the top of a slope, sat the small Keldabe suburb of [[Bralsin]].<ref name="Revelation" />

When the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Battle of Mandalore (Yuuzhan Vong War)|attacked]] Mandalore during their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], in retribution for the Mandalorians' actions against them,<ref name="Sacrifice">''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''</ref> the Kelita valley suffered significant damage: more than a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] after the battle, swaths of the valley's land lay [[Death/Legends|dead]], [[Poison/Legends|poisoned]] by the Yuuzhan Vong.<ref name="Revelation" />

In [[41 ABY]], while staying on Mandalore to learn how to stop her [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] brother, [[Darth Caedus]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] met with the former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-turned-Mandalorian [[Bardan Jusik|Gotab]] near Bralsin, on a [[Granite/Legends|granite]] hill overlooking the Kelita valley. There, Solo sought spiritual advice on how best to deal with her [[Sith/Legends|fallen]] brother from the elderly [[Gender/Legends|man]] who had been both a member of the Old [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the Mandalorian warrior clans. While talking, the two enjoyed the scenic view of the valley, and watched groups of flying [[Bird/Legends|avians]] that made the valley their home.<ref name="Revelation" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Kelita valley first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe in the eighth entry into the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]'' novel series, [[Legacy of the Force: Revelation|''Revelation'']], written by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]] and published [[February 26]], [[2008]].<ref name="Revelation" /> The valley later received a mention in the series' final novel, [[Legacy of the Force: Invincible|''Invincible'']], written by [[Troy Denning]] and released several months later on [[May 13]], [[2008]].<ref name="Invincible">''[[Legacy of the Force: Invincible]]''</ref>
